source.original_text: For natural d,q satisfying2q+1<d, put r=q+1, including q=0. Use Omega=(R^d)^r and the original product mu of r independent standard d-dimensional Gaussian column laws. Phi_i is the physical row with coordinates omega(b)_i. Put theta_i=(i-1/2)pi/d, t_i=(1,sqrt(2)cos(theta_i),...,sqrt(2)cos(q theta_i)), L=2r+3log(1000d), and w_i=cos((2q+1)theta_i). Define Yi=d^(-1)(Phi_i Phi_i^T tensor t_i t_i^T) on norm(Phi_i)^2<=L and zero otherwise; Mi is its actual Bochner integral under the same original unconditional mu, Zi=Yi-Mi. Put a=r^(-1) integral norm(x)^2 times the inclusive cutoff indicator under the standard r-dimensional Gaussian. Define the actual d by r^2 matrix B by B_(i,(b,k))=sqrt(d)^(-1) Phi_i(b)t_i(k), with Gaussian index first, and let G be the event that every actual row satisfies its inclusive cutoff. For every original sample omega in G, sum_i Zi(omega)=B(omega)^T B(omega)-a I_(r^2), and sum_i wi Zi(omega)=B(omega)^T diag(w) B(omega). These are the two actual eventwise centered Gram identities of Ex125. No probability of G or concentration event is asserted.

decoder_context: Fin n is the finite set of natural numbers strictly less than n; i.val is the zero-based natural value of i. Natural numbers embed into the reals in the usual way.

EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its Euclidean norm and Borel structure. WithLp.toLp 2 wraps a coordinate function as a Euclidean vector; WithLp.ofLp recovers its same coordinates.
stdGaussian is the centered Gaussian probability law with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the displayed finite product measure on the corresponding function space.
Real.log is the natural logarithm; Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root. Set.indicator S f is f on S and zero off S. An if-condition written with less-than-or-equal includes equality.

Matrix is the displayed finite real matrix space. Matrix.vecMulVec u v has entry u_i v_j. Matrix.kronecker A B has entry A_(i,k) B_(j,l) at row (i,j) and column (k,l). transpose interchanges matrix indices; multiplication is ordinary matrix multiplication.

Matrix.diagonal w has diagonal entry w_i and every off-diagonal entry zero. The matrix 1 is the identity on its displayed finite index set. Scalar multiplication, subtraction and finite sums have their usual real matrix meanings.
All matrix norms use the real Euclidean L2 operator norm of the displayed matrix action; they are not entrywise or coordinate sup norms. This norm has the standard finite-coordinate topology.

The integral notation is the Bochner integral in the displayed space. It is totalized to zero when its integrand is not integrable. Reconstruct the literal assertions as displayed; do not add an integrability hypothesis or conclusion.
A local function G from the sample space to Prop defines a condition on a sample. The arrow following G omega is logical implication, with all subsequent conjunctions under its scope.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumCosineGram

/-! Actual original-experiment centered Gram realizations on the literal closed
all-row cutoff event. Actual means and cosine-frame sums are internal inputs;
no arbitrary B, mean, Gram, frame, bias or probability certificate is supplied. -/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix Kronecker Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceGramRealization

theorem actual_source_centered_gram_realizations
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
    (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun ω i u =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (row i ω) u.1 * t i u.2
  let G : Ω → Prop := fun ω => ∀ i : Fin d, ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
  ∀ ω : Ω, G ω →
    ((∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) =
      (B ω).transpose * B ω - a •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)) ∧
    ((∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω) =
      (B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω)
 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
    (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun ω i u =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (row i ω) u.1 * t i u.2
  let G : Ω → Prop := fun ω => ∀ i : Fin d, ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let tensor : M →ₗ[ℝ] N :=
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N) (1 : M)
  let K : Fin d → N := fun i => tensor (feature i)
  have moments := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean.actual_source_truncated_matrix_means
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (Y i) μ) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • K i) at moments
  have half_grid (i : Fin d) :
      ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ) = θ i := by
    dsimp only [θ]
    ring
  have frame := FixedSpectrumCosineGram.actual_cosine_frame_gram (d := d) (q := q) hq
  dsimp only at frame
  simp_rw [half_grid] at frame
  change t.transpose * t = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) ∧
    t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * t = 0 ∧ _ at frame
  have gram : (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) := by
    ext j k
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ feature
      _ = ((d : ℝ) • (1 : M)) j k := by
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using
          congrFun (congrFun frame.1 j) k
  have weighted_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) = 0 := by
    ext j k
    have weighted_entry := congrFun (congrFun frame.2.1 j) k
    change (∑ i : Fin d, (t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w) j i * t i k) = 0 at weighted_entry
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply] at weighted_entry
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, w i * (t i j * t i k) :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ (fun i => w i • feature i)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * w i * t i k := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = (0 : M) j k := weighted_entry
  have tensor_one : tensor (1 : M) = (1 : N) := by
    change Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (1 : M) = (1 : N)
    dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
    exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
  have tensor_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) := (map_sum tensor _ _).symm
      _ = (d : ℝ) • tensor (1 : M) := by rw [gram, map_smul]
      _ = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by rw [tensor_one]
  have weighted_tensor : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
        rfl
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_gram, map_zero]
  have hd : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 by omega)
  have mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = a • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, K i) := by
        simp_rw [moments.2]
        exact Finset.smul_sum.symm
      _ = a • (1 : N) := by
        rw [tensor_gram, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ a hd]
  have weighted_mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) =
          (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [moments.2 i]
        exact smul_comm _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_tensor, smul_zero]
  have inv_sqrt_square :
      (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ = (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ = ((Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [pow_two, mul_inv]
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have actual_row_outer (i : Fin d) (ω : Ω) (hi : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L)
      (u v : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) :
      B ω i u * B ω i v = Y i ω u v := by
    calc
      _ = ((Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹) *
          ((row i ω u.1 * row i ω v.1) * (t i u.2 * t i v.2)) := by
        dsimp only [B]
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [inv_sqrt_square]
        simp only [Y, if_pos hi, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.kronecker,
          Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have actual_gram (ω : Ω) (hG : G ω) :
      (B ω).transpose * B ω = ∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω := by
    ext u v
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact actual_row_outer i ω (hG i) u v
  have actual_weighted_gram (ω : Ω) (hG : G ω) :
      (B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω = ∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω := by
    ext u v
    change (∑ i : Fin d, ((B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w) u i * B ω i v) =
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω) u v
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    calc
      B ω i u * w i * B ω i v = w i * (B ω i u * B ω i v) := by ring
      _ = w i * Y i ω u v := by rw [actual_row_outer i ω (hG i) u v]
  change ∀ ω : Ω, G ω →
    ((∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) = (B ω).transpose * B ω - a • (1 : N)) ∧
    ((∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω) = (B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω)
  intro ω hG
  constructor
  · calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) = (∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω) - a • (1 : N) := by
        simp only [Z, mean, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mean_sum]
      _ = _ := by rw [actual_gram ω hG]
  · calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω) =
          (∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω) - (∑ i : Fin d, w i • mean i) := by
        simp only [Z, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = (∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω) := by
        change (∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω) -
          (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) = _
        rw [weighted_mean_sum, sub_zero]
      _ = _ := (actual_weighted_gram ω hG).symm

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceGramRealization

formulae.label: Actual centered Gram identities on the source event

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), \(r=q+1\), and \(n=2q+1\). The case \(q=0\) is included; needed positivity follows internally.
On \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), use the original probability \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), with \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The actual physical row is \(\Phi_i=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\).

Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\), and \(w_i=\cos(n\theta_i)\). For a Lean row index \(j:\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), the source row index is \(j.val+1\).

Define \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\), \(M_i=\int Y_i\,d\mu\), and \(Z_i=Y_i-M_i\). All means use the same original unconditional \(\mu\). The canonical actual-mean theorem establishes integrability internally.

Define the actual scalar \(a=r^{-1}\int_{\mathbb R^r}\|x\|^2\mathbf1_{\{\|x\|^2\le L\}}\,d\gamma_r(x)\). The actual matrix has entries \(B_{i,(b,k)}=d^{-1/2}\Phi_i(b)t_i(k)\), with the Gaussian coordinate first. Put \(D_n=\operatorname{diag}(w_i)\).

The source event \(\mathcal T=\{\omega:\|\Phi_i(\omega)\|^2\le L\text{ for every }i\}\) is denoted \(G\) in Lean. The public conclusion is pointwise on this inclusive event. Matrix norms are real Euclidean operator norms.

Private consumer only: for every real \(\Delta\), let \(\mathcal E_\Delta=\{\|\sum_iZ_i\|_{\rm op}\le\Delta,\ \|\sum_iw_iZ_i\|_{\rm op}\le\Delta\}\). The norm conclusion is on \(\mathcal T\cap\mathcal E_\Delta\). This explicitly generalizes the source numeric threshold to an arbitrary real threshold; it does not assert the probability of either event.

  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
    (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun ω i u =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (row i ω) u.1 * t i u.2
  let G : Ω → Prop := fun ω => ∀ i : Fin d, ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L

steps.title: Assemble the actual mean and weighted mean
steps.text: Call the canonical actual-mean theorem and the canonical cosine-frame theorem. An internal arithmetic equality aligns the two identical midpoint-index conventions. Finite linearity of the fixed map A↦Ir⊗A transports the feature sums. Since d>0, the actual mean sums are aI and zero; these are derived facts, not caller certificates.
steps.lean:
let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let tensor : M →ₗ[ℝ] N :=
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N) (1 : M)
  let K : Fin d → N := fun i => tensor (feature i)
  have moments := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean.actual_source_truncated_matrix_means
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (Y i) μ) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • K i) at moments
  have half_grid (i : Fin d) :
      ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ) = θ i := by
    dsimp only [θ]
    ring
  have frame := FixedSpectrumCosineGram.actual_cosine_frame_gram (d := d) (q := q) hq
  dsimp only at frame
  simp_rw [half_grid] at frame
  change t.transpose * t = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) ∧
    t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * t = 0 ∧ _ at frame
  have gram : (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) := by
    ext j k
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ feature
      _ = ((d : ℝ) • (1 : M)) j k := by
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using
          congrFun (congrFun frame.1 j) k
  have weighted_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) = 0 := by
    ext j k
    have weighted_entry := congrFun (congrFun frame.2.1 j) k
    change (∑ i : Fin d, (t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w) j i * t i k) = 0 at weighted_entry
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply] at weighted_entry
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, w i * (t i j * t i k) :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ (fun i => w i • feature i)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * w i * t i k := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = (0 : M) j k := weighted_entry
  have tensor_one : tensor (1 : M) = (1 : N) := by
    change Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (1 : M) = (1 : N)
    dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
    exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
  have tensor_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) := (map_sum tensor _ _).symm
      _ = (d : ℝ) • tensor (1 : M) := by rw [gram, map_smul]
      _ = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by rw [tensor_one]
  have weighted_tensor : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
        rfl
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_gram, map_zero]
  have hd : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 by omega)
  have mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = a • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, K i) := by
        simp_rw [moments.2]
        exact Finset.smul_sum.symm
      _ = a • (1 : N) := by
        rw [tensor_gram, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ a hd]
  have weighted_mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) =
          (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [moments.2 i]
        exact smul_comm _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_tensor, smul_zero]

steps.title: Expand the actual Gram entries on the inclusive event
steps.text: Square the real inverse-square-root normalization. On the retained branch each product of B-row entries is exactly the corresponding actual Yi entry. Every row satisfies that branch on T. The ordinary matrix product and diagonal multiplication therefore give both Gram sums, with the original paired-index order.
steps.formula: \frac1{\sqrt d}\frac1{\sqrt d}=\frac1d,\qquad\omega\in\mathcal T\Longrightarrow B^\top B=\sum_iY_i,\quad B^\top D_nB=\sum_iw_iY_i.

private theorem actual_source_gram_deviation_bounds
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :

  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))

    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
    (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun ω i u =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (row i ω) u.1 * t i u.2
  let G : Ω → Prop := fun ω => ∀ i : Fin d, ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
  ∀ Δ : ℝ, ∀ ω : Ω, G ω →
    ((‖∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω‖ ≤ Δ) ∧
      (‖∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω‖ ≤ Δ)) →
    ((‖(B ω).transpose * B ω -
        (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)‖
        ≤ Δ + (1 - a)) ∧
      (‖(B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω‖ ≤ Δ))

  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)

        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0

    fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let a : ℝ := (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}

  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let B : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun ω i u =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * (row i ω) u.1 * t i u.2
  let G : Ω → Prop := fun ω => ∀ i : Fin d, ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  have hp := FixedSpectrumSourceGramRealization.actual_source_centered_gram_realizations
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ ω : Ω, G ω →
    ((∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) = (B ω).transpose * B ω - a • (1 : N)) ∧
    ((∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω) =
      (B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω)) at hp
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have moment := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.StdGaussianMoment.integrable_norm_sq_and_integral_stdGaussian
    (E := E)
  have hgood : MeasurableSet {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L} :=
    measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have hret := moment.1.indicator hgood

    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ x : E, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂stdGaussian E := by
        apply integral_mono hret moment.1
        intro x
        by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
        · simp [Set.indicator, hx]
        · simpa [Set.indicator, hx] using sq_nonneg ‖x‖

steps.title: Obtain the actual eventwise Gram-deviation bounds
steps.text: The identity matrix has Euclidean operator norm1 because r² is positive. Thus the actual bias matrix has norm1−a. Combine the exact bias identity with triangle inequality and the two actual centered-sum deviation antecedents. The statement quantifies over every real threshold; for negative thresholds the norm antecedent cannot hold. This proves a deterministic implication, with no event-probability conclusion.
steps.lean:
have identity_norm : ‖(1 : N)‖ = 1 := norm_one
  have bias_norm : ‖(1 - a) • (1 : N)‖ = 1 - a := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1),
      identity_norm, mul_one]
  have actual_bias_identity (ω : Ω) (hG : G ω) :
      (B ω).transpose * B ω - (1 : N) =
        (∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) - (1 - a) • (1 : N) := by
    rw [(hp ω hG).1]
    have split_identity : a • (1 : N) + (1 - a) • (1 : N) = (1 : N) := by
      rw [← add_smul, show a + (1 - a) = (1 : ℝ) by ring, one_smul]
    calc
      _ = (B ω).transpose * B ω - (a • (1 : N) + (1 - a) • (1 : N)) := by
        rw [split_identity]
      _ = _ := by abel
  change ∀ Δ : ℝ, ∀ ω : Ω, G ω →
    ((‖∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω‖ ≤ Δ) ∧ (‖∑ i : Fin d, w i • Z i ω‖ ≤ Δ)) →
    ((‖(B ω).transpose * B ω - (1 : N)‖ ≤ Δ + (1 - a)) ∧
      (‖(B ω).transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * B ω‖ ≤ Δ))
  intro Δ ω hG hΔ
  constructor
  · calc
      ‖(B ω).transpose * B ω - (1 : N)‖ =
          ‖(∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω) - (1 - a) • (1 : N)‖ := by
        rw [actual_bias_identity ω hG]
      _ ≤ ‖∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω‖ + ‖(1 - a) • (1 : N)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖∑ i : Fin d, Z i ω‖ + (1 - a) := by rw [bias_norm]
      _ ≤ Δ + (1 - a) := add_le_add hΔ.1 (le_refl (1 - a))
  · rw [← (hp ω hG).2]
    exact hΔ.2

reconstruction.text:
For every pair of natural numbers \(d,q\) and every hypothesis
\[
2q+1<d,
\]
make the following local definitions. All finite indices below are zero based: \(i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)\) has values \(0,\ldots,d-1\), and \(b,c,k,\ell\in\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)\) have values \(0,\ldots,q\). Natural numbers occurring in real expressions are embedded in \(\mathbb R\).

Let
\[
D=\mathbb R^d,\qquad E=\mathbb R^{q+1},\qquad
\Omega=\{\omega:\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)\to D\},
\]
where \(D\) and \(E\) are Euclidean spaces, and let the measure on \(\Omega\) be
\[
\mu=\bigotimes_{b\in\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)}\operatorname{stdGaussian}(D).
\]
Here \(\operatorname{stdGaussian}\) is the centered Gaussian probability law with identity covariance. Define the real numbers
\[
r=(q+1)\in\mathbb R,\qquad
L=2r+3\log(1000d),
\]
where \(\log\) denotes the natural logarithm. For \(i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)\), define
\[
\theta_i=\frac{(i+1-\tfrac12)\pi}{d},\qquad
t_{i,k}=\begin{cases}
1,&k=0,\\
\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i),&k\ne0,
\end{cases}
\quad k\in\operatorname{Fin}(q+1).
\]
For \(i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)\) and \(\omega\in\Omega\), let
\[
\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)=(\omega_b(i))_{b\in\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)}\in E.
\]
The norm of this row, and of every vector of \(E\) below, is its Euclidean norm.

Let \(I=\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)\times\operatorname{Fin}(q+1)\). Define an \(I\)-by-\(I\) real matrix \(Y_i(\omega)\) by
\[
Y_i(\omega)=
\begin{cases}
d^{-1}\bigl(\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)^{\mathsf T}\bigr)
\otimes(t_i t_i^{\mathsf T}),&\|\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)\|^2\le L,\\
0,&\text{otherwise}.
\end{cases}
\]
The index order in this Kronecker product is the following: for row index \((b,k)\in I\) and column index \((c,\ell)\in I\),
\[
\bigl(Y_i(\omega)\bigr)_{(b,k),(c,\ell)}=
\begin{cases}
d^{-1}\omega_b(i)\omega_c(i)t_{i,k}t_{i,\ell},&\|\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)\|^2\le L,\\
0,&\text{otherwise}.
\end{cases}
\]
Set
\[
\operatorname{mean}_i=\int_\Omega Y_i(\omega)\,d\mu(\omega),\qquad
Z_i(\omega)=Y_i(\omega)-\operatorname{mean}_i.
\]
Define the real number
\[
a=\frac1r\int_E
\mathbf 1_{\{y\in E:\|y\|^2\le L\}}(x)\,\|x\|^2\,
 d\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)(x),
\]
where the integrand is \(\|x\|^2\) on the displayed set and zero off that set. All displayed integrals are Bochner integrals in the displayed spaces, with value zero when their integrands are not integrable.

Define
\[
w_i=\cos\bigl((2q+1)\theta_i\bigr),
\]
where \(2q+1\) is first formed as a natural number and then embedded in \(\mathbb R\). For each \(\omega\in\Omega\), define the real matrix \(B(\omega)\), with row index in \(\operatorname{Fin}(d)\) and column index in \(I\), by
\[
B(\omega)_{i,(b,k)}=(\sqrt d)^{-1}\,
\bigl(\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)\bigr)_b\,t_{i,k}.
\]
Here each square root is the nonnegative square root. Finally define the condition
\[
G(\omega)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\forall i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d),\quad
\|\operatorname{row}_i(\omega)\|^2\le L.
\]

Then, for every \(\omega\in\Omega\), the condition \(G(\omega)\) implies the conjunction of the following two equalities of \(I\)-by-\(I\) real matrices:
\[
\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)}Z_i(\omega)
=B(\omega)^{\mathsf T}B(\omega)-a\,\mathrm{Id}_I
\]
and
\[
\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)}w_i Z_i(\omega)
=B(\omega)^{\mathsf T}\operatorname{diag}(w)B(\omega).
\]
Here \(\mathrm{Id}_I\) is the identity matrix on the ordered-pair index set \(I\), and \(\operatorname{diag}(w)\) is the \(\operatorname{Fin}(d)\)-by-\(\operatorname{Fin}(d)\) diagonal matrix with entries \(w_i\). Matrix products, finite sums, scalar multiplication, and subtraction have their ordinary real matrix meanings. Both equalities lie within the implication from \(G(\omega)\).
